purpose: Experiment E-FND-0087 in the foundations arena: no interaction of the fixed-mesh charge rule shifts the clock: the one interacting configuration (the same-cell head-on breather, whose amplitude departs from the union by exactly 3) is bound and clock-locked with phases 0 and 180, every separated pair is an exact union at every beat, a -1 tone carries the complex-conjugate phase sequence of a +1 (charge conjugation conjugates the amplitude), and the detector control (a defect seeded one beat late by hand) shows a phase shift would have been seen.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
